assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-provided provisional constraints derived from public descriptions and announced areas, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and spatial alignments are intake/design-discussion values and must be recalculated when official GIS/CAD polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire-control conditions, heritage protection and engineering constraints are not included in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, building height, building coverage, demolition, new construction, grade separation and parcel-level implementation remain unknown rather than inferred.

assumptions.statement: The proposal does not have a verified existing-building inventory, ground-floor use survey, station entrance inventory, pedestrian count or accessibility audit.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are reversible service envelopes, and walking links are conceptual audit routes rather than surveyed existing assets.

assumptions.statement: Official river blue lines, flood-control conditions, habitat baselines, green-space ownership and maintenance responsibilities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The Xiaoyue River wing and green-space polygons express low-disturbance design intent only; sensor placement and ecological intervention cannot proceed before review.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, legal responsibilities, complaint handlers and independent evaluators have not been appointed.
assumptions.impact: The five project packages and P0-P3 phases are condition-triggered proposals, not investment or delivery commitments.

assumptions.statement: The seven personas and ten scenarios synthesize task requirements and design hypotheses; they have not yet been validated with residents, workers, students, visitors or disabled users.
assumptions.impact: Access rules, non-digital alternatives, opening hours, thresholds and success criteria require co-design and task-based testing before implementation.

assumptions.statement: No single AI model, vendor, sensing stack or data-processing system is selected by this urban-design proposal.
assumptions.impact: Every future project needs a project-specific data, safety, accessibility, consumer-rights and human-review assessment before G0-G5 gate approval.
